Still below every named entry rate (TextMagic $0.049, SlickText ~$0.05, SimpleTexting $0.078) and right around the ~$0.04 industry average — but now slightly ABOVE SimpleTexting's mid-tier (~$0.032). Fairly/competitively priced; no longer underpriced at list.
